purpose: Render and edit conditional automation rules composed of conditions and actions.
useWhen: Building a UI for configuring which agents or services run based on event conditions.
You only need conditions (no actions) — pass mode="conditions" for a constrained operator set and typed value inputs.
Your data is one flat implicit-AND conditions list — pass mode="flat-conditions" without rule-group metadata.

avoidWhen.reason: You need to execute, validate, or persist rules — cinder owns none of that logic.
